name: Shell Prelude FLNG — 7 offshore footless marine loading arms (4 LNG, 3 LPG)
description: FMC Technologies contract with Technip France for Technip Samsung Consortium; designed/manufactured in Sens, France; Prelude built at Samsung Heavy Industries, Geoje, Korea; 488 m LOA, ~600,000 tonnes fully loaded, moored >200 km from land.
